question: Can you prompt an LLM to output the high frequency control commands for a legged robot in varying terrain?

plant.servo: position servos, kp 0.55 N·m/rad, forcerange ±0.6405 N·m (measured 2026-09-06)

protocol.perturbation: ±2 mm trunk, ±0.02 rad per joint, seed 0 nominal
protocol.fell: projected-gravity z > −0.7 or trunk z < 60 mm at any tick
protocol.standing: projected-gravity z < −0.9 and trunk z > 90 mm at the last tick
protocol.stepIsolation: step-step collision off (site/stairs.js isolateSteps); step-duck contact unchanged

flat.note: floor only; the stair bank parked 5 m below

ledge10.note: one 10 mm step up at x = 0.13 m, then flat

ledge15.note: one 15 mm step up at x = 0.13 m, then flat

ledge20.note: one 20 mm step up at x = 0.13 m, then flat

rough5.note: alternating 5 mm up/down ledges every 200 mm from x = 0.13 m

rough10.note: alternating 10 mm up/down ledges every 200 mm from x = 0.13 m

ramp5.note: a flight rising 5 mm every 200 mm, to 35 mm

ramp10.note: a flight rising 10 mm every 200 mm, to 70 mm
